rules: Use TeacherAwakening.iEquip as exact affected equip ID. cfg_Teacher.iAwakeningEquip is awakening material, not the affected equip.
Levels 1,2,3 map directly; 4 and 5 have description 敬请期待 and are reserved even when effect references exist.
iType 1 returns equipment and does not modify stat scoring.

iType 2 ReplaceAdjacent holds the complete replacement adjacent skill list. Use highest unlocked replacement set, or calculate marginal additions with skill ID deduplication; do not add baseline skills twice.
iType 3 arrParam triples are [mode,attribute,value]; mode 2 is percent. Values use denominator 10000. Active entries provide identical percentages for attack, defense and HP.

iType 4 arrParam [form,pct] increases same form attack/defense/HP excluding source. Its additive position alongside star/talent is an implementation inference until combat IL confirms. Do not claim rounding/stacking verified.
iType 5 [element,pct] is reserved for level 5; do not enable.
1005 and 1007 are self-per-adjacent skills; 1006 buffs adjacent treasures. Decode both arrParam and arrFlashParam preserving exact attributes.
2025 means damage bonus; 2069 means shield effect. Reference incorrectly uses 2025 for some shield effects.
